CustomField.description: When a Conditional line is required. Formula evaluated by PMTCondition only when the line applies (Condition__c empty or true): Condition__c supersedes it. Same syntax and prefix rule as Condition__c. Ignored unless Requirement__c = Conditional.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Salesforce formula returning true or false, read only when Requirement = Conditional. Prefix every field with its object: ProjectProduct__c.LegalForm__c, ProjectShareclass__c.HasPerfFees__c (Share Class fields only). Picklists: ISPICKVAL() or TEXT().
CustomField.label: Required Condition
